parsed.post: The last experiment (0.890247) was a slight regression from our current best (0.889708). It seems the current configuration is near a local optimum. I'll backtrack to the best commit and try adjusting the ASPECT_RATIO to see if changing the positional encoding/structure helps.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 128 to see if a different spatial configuration improves long-range modeling and lowers bpb.
